svg.title: Sound Creations Ltd Company Profile 2026 - Page 11

text.tspan: One of Kenya’s leading mega churches, with a round 2,500-seat sanctuary and a
central stage, needed sound that disperses equally in every direction, plus multitrack
recording for live performance. Comprehensive system simulations forecast
dispersion patterns and identified the optimal configuration for even SPL. Leveraging
our dB Technologies partnership, we deployed Ingenia loudspeakers, with a 168-
channel Midas Pro X console for expansive live recording.
